verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Canva shipping an official MCP *server* so external AI assistants can call Canva's tools (canva-docs-28, canva-probe-4, canva-probe-rt-2) — the opposite direction of this story, which asks whether Canva itself can plug in and consume external MCP servers. No evidence shows Canva acting as an MCP client that ingests third-party MCP tools.
